subject: general
question: Identify the alga that is NOT a marine algae.
solution:
The correct option is__** Chlorella.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chlorella is a genus of about thirteen species of **single-celled algae** belonging to the **division Chlorophyta.**
 
• During the late 1940s and the early 1950s,** Chlorella**** **was seen as a new and **promising primary food source.**
 
• It contains 50% proteins, almost 30% fats and about 20% nutrients and vitamins.
 
• **Chlorella is a fresh water algae.**
 
• A 2002 study showed that** Chlorella**** may cause inflammation. **But due to** its nutrient richness its highly consumed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Algae **are** photosynthetic eukaryotic organisms.**
 
• Types of algae:
 
 
• ​Chlorophyceae
 
• Phaeophyceae
 
• Rhodophyceae
 
 
 
• Chlorophyceae is also known as Green algae. Its generally found in freshwater, brackish water and saltwater.
 
• **Phaeophyceae** also commonly known as brown algae and only found in marine water.
 
• **Rhodophyceae**, known as red algae. These algae are mostly found in saltwater and brackish water but some of its species can be found in freshwater also.
